paper_title: Properties of Ultralight Bosons from Spins of Heavy Quasars via Superradiance
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV (upper bound on axion decay constant vs boson mass)
notes: Paper uses black-hole superradiance from heavy quasar (AGN) spins to constrain ultralight bosons (scalar/axion, vector, tensor). Primary particle-physics results: (1) exclusion of boson mass ranges via spin depletion (scalar 2.9e-21-1.7e-17 eV, vector 6.4e-22-1.7e-17 eV, tensor 2.6e-23-1.7e-17 eV) assuming negligible self-interaction; (2) upper bounds on the axion decay constant f_a vs mass mu (Fig. 6), which is the f_a-m_a plane => AxionMass. The emitted data_points are approximate readings of the upper-bound boundary curve of Fig. 6 (mu in eV vs f_a in GeV) and are UNCERTAIN because they were read off a rainbow-colored region plot with no numeric table. This is an observational/derived astrophysical bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
